note: The original description is Holmgren 1910 ('Versuch einer Monographie der amerikanischen Eutermes-Arten', soldier and worker), but no lawful open-access full text of that work could be obtained; all the content of this entry is taken from Emerson's complete redescription of 1925 based on the Kartabo material (including the alate and measurements), and no text of Holmgren 1910 that could not be seen has been used. Emerson 1925 was extracted from the OCR of a library scan on Internet Archive.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (based on the queen) Head dark brown, oval, covered with hairs and long setae; fontanelle small and short, forked at the apex. Antennal segments 2 and 3 equal in length, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3. Compound eyes large, not especially prominent, rather close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli smaller, almost flat against the surface of the head, separated from the compound eye by slightly more than their diameter. Labrum slightly paler than the head; postclypeus dark brown, the median line absent or indistinct. Pronotum dark brown, locally paler than the head, narrower than the head, the lateral margins rounded, the posterior margin deeply concave, the corners rounded. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum broadly concave, the corners sharp or rounded. Abdominal tergites dark brown. Measurements: head length 1.96—1.99 mm; head width 1.83—1.86 mm; compound eye diameter 0.55—0.57 mm; pronotum length 0.87—0.90 mm, width 1.57—1.70 mm; hind tibia length 1.93—2.02 mm; queen body length 27 mm, abdominal width 6 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-brown, large, with a straight outline, the swelling at the base of the nasus almost indistinguishable; 4 setae at the base of the nasus and 2 on the vertex. Antennae yellow, 13-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 equal to segment 2 or slightly longer. Nasus slightly darker than the head, large and thick. Pronotum yellow with a brownish anterior margin, with short hairs and a few longer setae. Legs yellow. Abdominal tergites yellow, covered with long hairs and with a row of marginal setae. Measurements: body length 4.00—5.00 mm; head length 1.65—1.83 mm; head width 1.10—1.22 mm; antennal length 1.80—1.90 mm; pronotum width 0.48—0.61 mm; hind tibia length 1.45—1.54 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Ephrata, Surinam (Holmgren 1910 described the soldier and worker). New localities: Kartabo and Tukeit, British Guiana. Distribution: Surinam, British Guiana.
